provenance: Hand-authored fictional retrieval contract smoke corpus. Every source is explicitly graded for each query; not a representative workload or independently adjudicated benchmark. Development/test categories each have one query. No profile was tuned using these judgments.
embedding_provenance: Hand-authored four-dimensional vectors for deterministic protocol/ranking evaluation. Not language model embeddings; semantic relevance claims are not supported.

conditions.limits_kind: experimental trial budgets within implementation ceilings; not tenant policy
conditions.cache: one warmup pass; RocksDB/OS caches not flushed; no retrieval-result cache
conditions.ranking_parameters: immutable server profiles; no tuning on test queries

metrics_definition.relevance_grades: 0 irrelevant, 1 marginal, 2 useful, 3 directly resolves the information need
metrics_definition.ndcg: DCG@10 = sum((2^grade-1)/log2(rank+1)); divide by ideal DCG from judgments; null if no relevant judged source
metrics_definition.recall: grade > 0; exhaustive recall only when every corpus record is explicitly judged; otherwise report judged recall separately
metrics_definition.unjudged: treated as gain zero for judged nDCG; expose coverage
metrics_definition.no_answer: unanswerable queries excluded from nDCG/recall averages and reported through returned/empty rates

lexical.method: paired query bootstrap, 2000 draws, percentile 95%; exploratory, no multiplicity correction

semantic.method: paired query bootstrap, 2000 draws, percentile 95%; exploratory, no multiplicity correction

resources.scope: entire container including telemetry commands and any concurrent clients; memory peak is since container start, not isolated trial peak

embedding_measurements.reason: Frozen externally supplied vectors are reused. No model invocation occurs in this trial; do not interpret missing generation measurements as zero.

agent_task_evaluation.reason: A fixed model, prompt, tools, task suite and acceptance outcomes are required separately.

qualification.reason: Synthetic contract evidence cannot qualify language relevance. Review held-out gains, uncertainty, exact-query regressions and separate agent-task outcomes before adoption.

deployment.environment: Disposable local Docker acceptance volume, removed after validation
deployment.process_restart: Same frozen source IDs, revisions and rankings verified before and after SIGKILL

report_context: Synthetic contract trial only. Not language-model relevance qualification; hybrid is not admitted.
